title: Derived restriction and coherent evaluation for projective diagrams
statement: Use simplicial sets and coherent functors of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the coherent realization, projective model structures and covariant unstraightening $U^{\mathrm{cov}}$ of [lem-coef-simplicial-right-fibration-presentation], and the enriched-evaluation rectification comparison of [lem-coef-enriched-diagram-rectification], in fixed sufficiently large universes. Let $u:B\to A$ be a map of small simplicial sets and let $F:\mathfrak C[A]\to\mathsf{sSet}$ be a projectively cofibrant-fibrant simplicial functor. Put $D=F\circ\mathfrak C[u]$. Functorially factor $\varnothing\to D$ as a projective cofibration $\varnothing\to QD$ followed by a projective trivial fibration $QD\to D$. Then $QD$ is cofibrant-fibrant and $QD\to D$ is an objectwise weak homotopy equivalence. If $\Phi_A$ and $\Phi_B$ denote the enriched-evaluation rectification comparisons, there is a coherent equivalence $\Phi_B(QD)\simeq\Phi_A(F)\circ u$, natural in $F$ and $u$ after localization, including their transformations and higher simplices and compatible with composition of base maps. The map $U^{\mathrm{cov}}_B(QD)\to U^{\mathrm{cov}}_B(D)\cong u^*U^{\mathrm{cov}}_A(F)$ is an equivalence of left fibrations over $B$.

source.place: Proposition 2.2.1.1 (base-change isomorphism), Theorem 2.2.1.2 and Proposition 4.2.4.4 (projective replacement and enriched evaluation); derived-restriction naturality is the auxiliary argument extracted from the item, not a verbatim theorem of HTT.
